The eighth season of Game of Thrones aired in 2019, and it concluded the main series.

However, there are several upcoming Game of Thrones spin-offs in development. These include "House of the Dragon," which is set 200 years before the events of the main series and focuses on the Targaryen civil war called the Dance of the Dragons. Another spin-off, "9 Voyages" (previously known as "Sea Snake"), follows Lord Corlys Velaryon and his journey to the farthest corners of the world. In the final season of Game of Thrones, titled Season 10, the story concludes with the major characters facing their final challenges. Daenerys Targaryen and Jon Snow continue their journey to the north to face the Army of the Dead in the epic battle at Winterfell. After defeating the Night King and his army, tensions rise among the remaining leaders as they vie for control over the Seven Kingdoms. Daenerys' descent into madness and tyranny leads to her clash with Jon Snow, ultimately ending in her demise. Bran Stark ascends to the Iron Throne, ruling as an observer without any true power, marking a new beginning for Westeros.

In Season 10 of Game of Thrones, Westeros sees a resurgent struggle for power, with new factions rising and old ones attempting to maintain their grip. Arya Stark returns to Winterfell with new allies from Essos, bringing a mysterious power that could change the balance of the realm. Meanwhile, Tyrion Lannister, now a key advisor in King’s Landing, navigates a treacherous political landscape as various noble houses vie for control. The series also explores the past, revealing more about the legendary figures who shaped the Seven Kingdoms, including deeper insights into the Targaryen lineage.

At the Wall, Jon Snow grapples with leadership challenges as the Night’s Watch faces new threats from beyond the Wall, hinting at a stirring in the North that defies nature. In King’s Landing, tensions rise as the Lannisters rebuild their influence amidst growing civil unrest and a secret plot threatens the throne from within. Daenerys Targaryen's legacy is painstakingly re-evaluated, as remnants of her armies seek to carry out what they believe were her final wishes, causing friction in Essos and across the sea.

The season builds up to a dramatic climax where secrets revealed in the Citadel unmask unknown heirs and hidden prophecies that could reshape the very future of Westeros. Power plays, magic, and an ancient menace culminate in a grand convergence that promises to redefine the fate of the Seven Kingdoms.

Game of Thrones Season 10, like the previous seasons, is based on George R.R. Martin's A Song of Ice and Fire series. The season consists of six episodes, with the first episode airing on May 19, 2019, and the final episode airing on May 19, 2019.

The season picks up where Season 9 left off, with Jon Snow and Daenerys Targaryen both claiming the Iron Throne. The season explores the consequences of their actions, as well as the power struggles between the remaining factions in Westeros.
